1921 Silver Dollar Value
1921 is a unique year: it is the only date struck as BOTH a Morgan dollar (its final year, in huge numbers) and the first-year Peace dollar. All are 90% silver, so they carry a strong silver melt floor — shown live below.

Key facts
1921 Morgan dollars are common (over 86 million struck) — value tracks silver in lower grades.
The 1921 Peace dollar (high relief, first year) is scarcer and more valuable.
Composition: 90% silver, ≈0.7734 oz per coin.
A 1921-D Morgan exists (Denver) — the only Denver-minted Morgan dollar.
